title: Citizen Hearing on Disclosure

tellings.quote: I recommend going to the what was called the citizens hearings in 2013. It's on YouTube.

plain: In 2013 a set of public hearings called the Citizen Hearing on Disclosure was held where people gave testimony about UFOs, and it is all on YouTube, according to Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he retrieved a UFO. Barber recommends watching it, without saying what was said there.
